useCases.title: Audit what Strawberry can do for my company
useCases.message: Run an audit of how I could use Strawberry across my workflow. You might want to start by mapping what you already know about my role, tools, and day-to-day tasks. Then match each area against what Strawberry can automate and give me a prioritised list of where to start.
